scope: Rows 1 and 2: systemd-sbsign ships inside the systemd package at /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-sbsign and is not on PATH (no dnf package exists; 'No match for argument' is expected); each docker run is a fresh ephemeral container so a dnf install in one does not persist; the sign command needs --private-key-source=provider:pkcs11 not engine:pkcs11 (ADR-008 / OMN-116, OpenSSL 3.x deprecates the engine API); the PKCS#11 URI must be single-quoted with the embedded PIN (pin-value) or signing hangs or C_Login fails.
